mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary conditions, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the rate increase, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the unemployment rate increase, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of periods with declining GDP, or if the correlation between GDP decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, which can lead to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the industrial production decline, or if the correlation between INDPRO declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates growing demand in the housing sector, which can lead to increased economic activity and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the increase in housing starts, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the labor market improvement, or if the joint effect of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate combined with a rise in consumer price index signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to increased nominal earnings and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the monetary conditions, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS decrease and CPIAUCSL increase on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals growing consumer demand, which can lead to increased corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the increase in consumption, or if the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
